name: Meta Officina
purpose: An invention workshop: rough words become a structured brief, a simulator scores designs, and a held-out gate decides what counts as proven.
proof: tests/officina/ (heatsink, design loop, brief, spec validator, pack shape)
limits: Design aid only. It never orders a build, ships a part, or presents a simulated score as a measured result.
notes: Stages 1 and 2a are in main; the held-out gate can reject a design the loop liked.
